ugPrograms.title: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in Commerce or Science stream recognized by the University of Mysore with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST/Cat-I).
ugPrograms.overview: A comprehensive undergraduate program in corporate accounting, financial analysis, direct & indirect taxation, auditing standards, banking law, and business compliance aligned with NEP 2020.

progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Direct progression for B.Com graduates with minimum 50% aggregate.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Senior Financial Analyst, Chartered Accountant (CA), Tax Consultant, Investment Banker.

ugPrograms.vision: To be a distinguished center for commerce and financial education, producing ethically grounded financial analysts, chartered accountants, and transformative corporate leaders.
ugPrograms.mission: To deliver contemporary accounting curricula, foster analytical decision-making, integrate digital financial technologies, and build corporate compliance competencies.

ugPrograms.title: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics / Biology optional combinations.
ugPrograms.overview: Foundational and applied scientific education across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biochemistry, Computer Science, and Life Sciences.

progressionPathway.targetDegree: M.Sc in Physics / Chemistry / Mathematics / CS / Biochemistry
progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Eligible for respective M.Sc subject majors upon graduation.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Scientific Research Scientist, Quantitative Analyst, Laboratory Officer, Academician.

ugPrograms.vision: The department strives to empower the students with scientific temper, logical reasoning and analytical power towards overall development in the modern society.
ugPrograms.mission: To provide rigorous theoretical and experimental physics education, foster curiosity and laboratory innovation, and prepare students for research leadership in national laboratories and global universities.

ugPrograms.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination (PUC) with Mathematics / Computer Science / Statistics / Accountancy / Commerce recognized by University of Mysore.
ugPrograms.overview: Industry-driven undergraduate education in software engineering, full-stack web architectures, mobile app development, database systems, algorithms, and cloud deployments.

progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Direct progression to AICTE-approved MCA program for BCA graduates.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Enterprise Software Architect, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Cloud Systems Engineer, AI Specialist.

ugPrograms.vision: To be a premier center of technical excellence producing innovative software professionals, ethical technocrats, and visionary entrepreneurs capable of addressing complex global digital challenges.
ugPrograms.mission: To impart comprehensive foundation in core algorithms, full-stack architectures, and AI systems; to foster industry-aligned experiential coding and research; to nurture ethical values and leadership in computing.

ugPrograms.title: Bachelor of Arts (B.A)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in Arts, Science, or Commerce stream recognized by University of Mysore.
ugPrograms.overview: Rigorous liberal arts curriculum covering English Literature, Economics, History, Political Science, Sociology, Journalism, and Psychology.

progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Direct progression into respective M.A. postgraduate programs.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Civil Services (IAS/KAS), Public Policy Analyst, Media Producer, Academic Scholar.

ugPrograms.vision: To empower students through a deep engagement with literature and language, fostering creativity, ethical values, and a global perspective.
ugPrograms.mission: To develop critical hermeneutics, communicative mastery, and cross-cultural appreciation through literary discourse and creative expression.

ugPrograms.title: Bachelor of Social Work (BSW)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in any stream with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST/Cat-I).
ugPrograms.overview: Professional field-work oriented social work education covering social case work, community organization, child welfare, medical & psychiatric social work, and rural immersion.

progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Seamless direct progression to MSW program.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Medical Social Worker, CSR Program Manager, NGO Director, HR & Industrial Relations Lead.

ugPrograms.vision: Be the change you want to see in the world.
ugPrograms.mission: Changing the mindset of the students. Make them more people-centric with extensive outreach programs to reach and uplift vulnerable communities.

ugPrograms.title: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in Arts, Science, or Commerce stream recognized by University of Mysore with minimum 40% aggregate.
ugPrograms.overview: Strategic management, marketing, human resource development, corporate finance, startup entrepreneurship, supply chains, and business analytics.

progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Direct pathway to AICTE-approved MBA program.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Corporate Strategist, Brand Manager, Financial Management Trainee, Startup Founder.

ugPrograms.vision: To see our graduates making meaningful contributions to the growth and transformation of the global business, tourism, and hospitality landscape, inspiring professionals who deliver excellence with empathy and purpose.
ugPrograms.mission: To prepare graduates who will positively impact the management, corporate, tourism, and hospitality sectors with professionalism, creativity, and a deep commitment to service.

ugPrograms.title: BBA in Tourism & Hospitality Management (BBA-TH)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in any stream with minimum 40% aggregate.
ugPrograms.overview: Specialized managerial education in international travel operations, airline ticketing (GDS), hotel front office management, culinary arts, resort operations, and event management.

progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Eligible through PGCET / KMAT for executive MBA admissions.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Luxury Resort General Manager, Tourism Operations VP, International Airline Operations Officer.

ugPrograms.vision: To see our graduates making meaningful contributions to the growth and transformation of the global business, tourism, and hospitality landscape, inspiring professionals who deliver excellence with empathy and purpose.
ugPrograms.mission: To prepare graduates who will positively impact the management, corporate, tourism, and hospitality sectors with professionalism, creativity, and a deep commitment to service.

ugPrograms.title: Bachelor of Vocation (B.Voc)
ugPrograms.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in any stream recognized by University of Mysore.
ugPrograms.overview: UGC-approved skill-development degree with specializations in Healthcare Technology, Media & Entertainment, Information Technology, and Hospitality Management.

progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Healthcare Diagnostic Specialist, Broadcast Video Editor, IT Operations Lead, Hotel Manager.

ugPrograms.vision: To bridge the gap between academic education and industry skill requirements through outcome-oriented vocational training.
ugPrograms.mission: To empower youth with industry-certified skills, hands-on clinical and technical internships, and job-ready competencies in healthcare, media, IT, and hospitality.

pgPrograms.title: M.Sc in Chemistry
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major/optional subject with minimum 45% aggregate in cognate subject (40% for SC/ST/Cat-I).
pgPrograms.overview: Advanced postgraduate studies in Organic Synthesis, Medicinal Chemistry, Analytical Spectroscopy, Inorganic Reaction Mechanisms, Physical Chemistry, and laboratory research dissertation.
pgPrograms.vision: Strive to create knowledge and empower students to take best advantage of their educational and research opportunities in chemical sciences.
pgPrograms.mission: To impart quality chemical education through modern experimental laboratories, promote sustainable green chemistry, and inspire student research towards pharmaceutical and industrial solutions.

pgPrograms.title: M.A in Economics
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.A. with Economics as a cognate subject with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST/Cat-I).
pgPrograms.overview: Advanced Microeconomics, Macroeconomic Policy, Econometrics, Public Finance, Development Economics, Monetary Economics, and International Trade.
pgPrograms.vision: The department envisions achieving excellence in teaching and significant research to provide quality education to students, and prepare professional leaders to address the emerging global economic and social challenges.
pgPrograms.mission: To cultivate analytical command over macroeconomic policies, econometrics, and developmental finance, realizing the founding vision of human empowerment.

pgPrograms.title: M.Sc in Physics
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.Sc. with Physics and Mathematics as optional subjects with minimum 45% aggregate in Physics.
pgPrograms.overview: Quantum Mechanics, Solid State Physics, Nuclear & Particle Physics, Electrodynamics, Statistical Mechanics, Computational Physics, and experimental research projects.
pgPrograms.vision: The department strives to empower the students with scientific temper, logical reasoning and analytical power towards overall development in the modern society.
pgPrograms.mission: To provide rigorous theoretical and experimental physics education, foster curiosity and laboratory innovation, and prepare students for research leadership in national laboratories and global universities.

pgPrograms.title: M.Sc in Computer Science
pgPrograms.degree: Master of Science in Computer Science
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.Sc. with Computer Science / Mathematics / Electronics or BCA with minimum 45% aggregate.
pgPrograms.overview: Advanced Algorithms, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, Deep Neural Networks, Cloud Architectures, and research project thesis.
pgPrograms.vision: To foster scientific temper, theoretical computing rigor, and advanced research in computing, empowering students to lead next-generation technological innovations.
pgPrograms.mission: To deliver high-impact computational curricula, state-of-the-art laboratory experimentation, interdisciplinary research collaborations, and outcome-oriented algorithmic learning.

pgPrograms.title: M.Sc in Biochemistry
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.Sc. with Biochemistry / Chemistry / Life Sciences with minimum 45% aggregate in cognate subjects.
pgPrograms.overview: Molecular Biology, Enzymology, Clinical Immunology, Genetic Engineering, Bio-membrane Transport, and pharmaceutical biotechnology research.
pgPrograms.vision: To achieve academic excellence in biochemistry by imparting in-depth knowledge to the students, facilitating research activities and catering to the ever changing industrial demands & societal needs.
pgPrograms.mission: To develop skilled biochemical analysts, encourage molecular research, and bridge academic science with clinical diagnostics and biotechnology sectors.

pgPrograms.title: M.Sc in Mathematics
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.Sc. with Mathematics as a major/optional subject with minimum 45% aggregate in Mathematics.
pgPrograms.overview: Real Analysis, Complex Analysis, Abstract Algebra, Topology, Differential Geometry, Graph Theory, Numerical Analysis, and Functional Analysis.
pgPrograms.vision: To develop mathematical rigor, abstract deduction, and analytical problem-solving skills that serve as the fundamental foundation for all scientific and technological pursuits.
pgPrograms.mission: To provide mastery in pure and applied mathematics, foster research in numerical analysis and discrete structures, and prepare students for competitive national examinations and academic excellence.

pgPrograms.title: Master of Social Work (MSW)
pgPrograms.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in BSW / B.A. / B.Sc. / B.Com. / BBA with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST/Cat-I).
pgPrograms.overview: Advanced social work specializations in Human Resource Management (HRM), Medical & Psychiatric Social Work (MPSW), and Community Development (CD) with continuous concurrent fieldwork.
pgPrograms.vision: Be the change you want to see in the world.
pgPrograms.mission: Changing the mindset of the students. Make them more people-centric with extensive outreach programs to reach and uplift vulnerable communities.

pgPrograms.title: M.A in English
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.A. with English as a cognate/optional subject or general degree with minimum 45% aggregate.
pgPrograms.overview: British Literature, Postcolonial Studies, American Literature, Critical Theory & Literary Hermeneutics, Indian Writing in English, and Linguistics.
pgPrograms.vision: To empower students through a deep engagement with literature and language, fostering creativity, ethical values, and a global perspective.
pgPrograms.mission: To develop critical hermeneutics, communicative mastery, and cross-cultural appreciation through literary discourse and creative expression.

pgPrograms.title: Master of Commerce (M.Com)
pgPrograms.eligibility: B.Com / BBA / BBM degree with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST/Cat-I candidates).
pgPrograms.overview: Corporate Accounting & Reporting (Ind-AS/IFRS), Strategic Financial Management, International Business, Direct & Indirect Tax Law, Security Analysis & Portfolio Management.
pgPrograms.vision: To be a distinguished center for commerce and financial education, producing ethically grounded financial analysts, chartered accountants, and transformative corporate leaders.
pgPrograms.mission: To deliver contemporary accounting curricula, foster analytical decision-making, integrate digital financial technologies, and build corporate compliance competencies.

pgPrograms.title: M.A in Journalism & Mass Communication
pgPrograms.degree: Master of Arts in Journalism & Mass Communication
pgPrograms.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University with minimum 45% aggregate.
pgPrograms.overview: Broadcast TV News Production, Investigative Reporting, Digital Media Strategy, Media Laws & Ethics, Documentary Filmmaking, Public Relations, and Advertising Campaigns.
pgPrograms.vision: To achieve excellence in media and communication education by fostering a dynamic and inclusive environment that promotes innovation, integrity, and a balance of classroom learning and hands-on experience.
pgPrograms.mission: To train fearless, ethical media practitioners, broadcast storytellers, and digital communicators dedicated to truth and democratic public dialogue.

pgPrograms.title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
pgPrograms.eligibility: Passed BCA/Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent Degree, OR Passed B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 Level or at Graduation Level with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved categories).
pgPrograms.overview: AICTE-approved postgraduate degree in Enterprise Cloud Architecture, Advanced Java & Python Frameworks, DevOps, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, and full semester industry capstone internship.
pgPrograms.vision: To be a premier center of technical excellence producing innovative software professionals, ethical technocrats, and visionary entrepreneurs capable of addressing complex global digital challenges.
pgPrograms.mission: To impart comprehensive foundation in core algorithms, full-stack architectures, and AI systems; to foster industry-aligned experiential coding and research; to nurture ethical values and leadership in computing.

pgPrograms.title: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
pgPrograms.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST/Cat-I) with valid PGCET / KMAT / CMAT score.
pgPrograms.overview: AICTE-approved MBA program with dual specializations in Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management, and Business Analytics. Features corporate internships, live simulation labs, and executive mentoring.
pgPrograms.vision: To see our graduates making meaningful contributions to the growth and transformation of the global business, tourism, and hospitality landscape, inspiring professionals who deliver excellence with empathy and purpose.
pgPrograms.mission: To prepare graduates who will positively impact the management, corporate, tourism, and hospitality sectors with professionalism, creativity, and a deep commitment to service.
